faq.welcome: Welcome {fullName}! This page shows tips and links tailored for your role.

learningDashboard.title: 📊 Learning Dashboard — what is it and how do I use it?
learningDashboard.body:
- The dashboard gives a **snapshot** of your activity (recent chats, enrolled courses, and progression).
- Use it as a **home base**: jump into courses or continue learning from recommendations.
- If tiles look empty, enroll in a course first from **My Courses**.

chatAssistant.title: 🤖 Chat Assistant — tips for getting great answers
chatAssistant.body:
- Ask questions about your uploaded documents or course topics.
- Use **citations/sources** shown under answers to preview or download supporting docs.
- To download a referenced document, use the **Download** button the assistant renders for that source.
- Clear chat: use the **Clear Chat** button in the configuration panel (you’ll be asked to confirm).

myCourses.title: 📚 My Courses — enroll, view, and manage
myCourses.body:
- **Enrolled** shows courses you’re currently taking.
- If a course reaches **100%**, you’ll see a **Completed** indicator (no Unenroll button).
- Otherwise, you can **View** details or **Unenroll** (confirmation dialog will appear).
- **Recommended** lists courses suggested from your **Knowledge Assessment** and learning signals.
- Click **Enroll** to join (confirmation dialog).
- Use **Refresh** to reload the latest data (progress or recommendations).

assessment.title: 🧠 Knowledge Assessment — how it works
assessment.body:
- Answer a short set of questions; we grade them with an **AI rater** on a 1–6 scale (1=very good, 6=unsatisfactory).
- You’ll see a **knowledge assessment**, **learning path**, and a **first learning step**.
- Recommendations are generated and shown on **My Courses → Recommended**.
- Make sure you submit **all answers**; the form checks for missing fields.

documents.title: 📄 My Documents — preview, download, and delete
documents.body:
- Shows files you’ve uploaded. Thumbnails (for PDFs) allow quick **Preview**; use **Download** to grab the file.
- **Delete…** prompts a confirmation dialog.
- **Delete All…** removes every file for your account (also with confirmation).
- Thumbnails for Markdown show a file-type icon instead of a PDF page image.

profileResults.title: 👤 Profile & 🔍 Evaluation Results
profileResults.body:
- **Profile** lets you review your account info.
- **Evaluation Results** aggregate outcomes from recent assessments (scores, summaries, and learning artifacts).

chatAssistant.title: 🤖 Chat Assistant — tips for getting great answers
chatAssistant.body:
- Ask questions about your uploaded documents or course topics.
- Use **citations/sources** shown under answers to preview or download supporting docs.
- To download a referenced document, use the **Download** button the assistant renders for that source.
- Clear chat: use the **Clear Chat** button in the configuration panel (you’ll be asked to confirm).

courseSetup.title: ✍️ Course Setup — create courses from documents
courseSetup.body:
- Upload **PDF** or **Markdown**, then **Process** to extract content.
- System can generate **summary** + **Q&A** to edit and save.
- Saved courses appear in **My Courses (Instructor)**
- On first login, a sample Markdown (**gamma_scanning_EducTUM.md**) is auto-uploaded to **My Documents** if missing.

myCourses.title: 📚 My Courses — view, edit, delete
myCourses.body:
- List shows ID, Title, Created, and Question count.
- **View** to edit Title/Summary/Q&A.
- **Delete** removes the course (confirmation) and cleans dependents.

documents.title: 📄 My Documents — managing course files
documents.body:
- Manage all uploaded files, including the default Markdown template.
- Preview, download, delete; **Delete All…** with confirmation.

profileResults.title: 👤 Profile & 🔍 Evaluation Results
profileResults.body:
- **Profile** lets you review your account info.
- **Evaluation Results** aggregate outcomes from recent assessments (scores, summaries, and learning artifacts).

dialogs.title: How do confirmations and dialogs work?
dialogs.body:
- Any destructive action (Delete, Unenroll, Clear Chat) triggers a **confirmation dialog** with **Confirm** and **Cancel**.
- This prevents accidental data loss.
- Simply choose **Cancel** to abort the action safely.

recommendations.title: Why don’t I see recommendations yet?
recommendations.body:
- Complete **Knowledge Assessment** first (for Learners).
- Click **Refresh** in **My Courses**.
- It’s possible current catalog items don’t strongly match your topics yet.

uploads.title: Troubleshooting uploads & previews
uploads.body:
- Encrypted/damaged PDFs may fail to preview.
- Markdown shows an icon (no page thumbnails) but still works in Chat.
- Duplicate content returns an “already processed” message.

eval.pageTitle: 🔍 Evaluation Results — Why do models vary in speed & quality?
eval.subtitle: You can view the LLM results!

dataset.caption: Below is the corpus used for the evaluations, with a short, non-technical overview.
dataset.explainerTitle: **What is this dataset and how was it used?**
dataset.explainer:
- **What you’re looking at:** a sample of real-world questions, short passages, and (where relevant) target grades.
- **Why this matters:** it shows the exact kind of material we used to check answer quality and grading reliability.
- **How we used it:**
  - For **chat**, we compare model answers to a reference answer.
  - For **grading**, we compare the model’s grade to a human grade.
- **How to read the table:** each row is one test case.
- **Limits:** it’s a sample, not everything; very unusual questions may behave differently.
- **Tip:** If you spot gaps, tell us — we can expand the dataset.
dataset.missingDataset: Dataset not found at `{path}`. Once your eval notebook exports it, it will appear here.

chatApertus.explainer:
- **Table:** One row per test showing per-metric scores and runtime.
- **Chart:** shows how answer quality is distributed (higher is better).
- **What affects speed/quality:** longer questions, larger context slow things down and initial loading of model from Hugging Face.
- **Takeaway:** Apertus-8B is the fast responder; for very complex tasks, try the larger model.
chatApertus.vizCaption: Distribution of chat quality (BERTScore F1) — Apertus
chatApertus.artifactsMissing: Artifacts not found yet. They’ll show up here after Admin run the evaluations and generate the reports.

chatLlama3.explainer:
- **Why this model:** larger = more detailed answers, but slower.
- **Table:** One row per test showing per-metric scores and runtime.
- **Chart:** overall quality tends to be higher than smaller models.
- **When to use:** complex, multi-step questions; you want depth over speed.
- **Takeaway:** Llama3.3:70B is the deep diver; expect slightly longer times.
chatLlama3.vizCaption: Distribution of chat quality (BERTScore F1) — Llama3.3
chatLlama3.artifactsMissing: Artifacts not found yet. They’ll show up here after Admin run the evaluations and generate the reports.

chatKimik2.explainer:
- **Why this model:** Chosen as a long-context instruct model to benchmark chat-style semantic quality and grounding.
- **Table:** One row per test showing per-metric scores and runtime.
- **Chart:** Histogram of per-test BERTScore F1 showing most answers cluster around ~0.60–0.62.
- **When to use:** When semantic similarity is acceptable, but not for strict grounding/RAG without improving retrieval + attribution.
- **Takeaway:** Moderate semantic quality (avg BERTScore F1 ≈ 0.61) with weak grounding (Recall@k/MRR modest; AttributionMatch very low).
chatKimik2.vizCaption: Distribution of chat quality (BERTScore F1) — Kimi-K2-Instruct-0905
chatKimik2.artifactsMissing: Artifacts not found yet. They’ll show up here after Admin run the evaluations and generate the reports.

grading.explainer:
- **Goal:** see how close the model's grades are to human grades.
- **Confusion matrix:** rows = human grade, columns = model grade; darker on the diagonal is good.
- **Metrics:** Accuracy (higher better), MAE (lower better), Agreement κ (closer to 1 better).
- **Reality check:** great on clear cases; borderline cases can vary like different teachers.
- **Tip:** treat the model grade as a starting point; keep quick human checks for key decisions.
grading.vizCaption: Confusion matrix — human vs model grades (rows = human, cols = model)
grading.artifactsMissing: Artifacts not found yet. They’ll show up here after Admin run the evaluations and generate the reports.
